fieldValues.title: Strict up-to-date protection and a head-bound quorum stall working-group PRs
fieldValues.summary: srs, srs-rust, srs-programme and clerk require a branch to be up to date before merging. Every merge leaves the other open PRs BEHIND. Upkeep updates ordinary auto PRs (srs-rust#1481 carried 10 'Merge branch master' commits) but never a working-group PR, because a new commit voids its quorum, so each merge elsewhere sends a group PR back for a fresh reviewer round. GitHub merge queue is unavailable: the-greenman is a personal account.
evidence: gh api branches/<default>/protection, 2026-10-28: strict=true on srs, srs-rust, srs-programme, clerk; srs-web unprotected
clerk lib/practice/upkeep.mjs:92 (group PR: no update-branch; a new commit voids the quorum) and :29 (quorum names the exact head)
srs-rust#1481: 10 master merges; srs-rust#1470: 7 master merges in 4 days
PRs merged 2026-10-26..28: srs 5 (avg 17.8h open), srs-rust 13 (avg 16.9h), srs-programme 23 (under 1h)
fieldValues.body:
- CI is not the bottleneck: srs-rust ci.yml runs 4-7 minutes.
- srs-programme flows because GitHub native auto-merge is armed on every PR (c373c2c1, clerk#208) and its PRs rarely touch the same file.
- The cost lands on the owner: the follow-up commits and conflicts on srs and srs-rust are what the owner unpicks by hand (vignette 913a3db6).
